name: Park Jae-Hyun
bio:
Park Jae-Hyun's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination with aerodynamics, fueled by watching fighter jets soar above his hometown. After graduating with a degree in Mechanical Engineering, he sought out opportunities in automotive research, eventually landing a coveted position at a national aerodynamics research facility. There, he honed his skills in wind tunnel testing and data analysis, contributing to the development of more efficient and stable vehicle designs.

His transition to motorsport was driven by a desire to apply his expertise in a more dynamic and competitive environment. He joined Brad Jones Racing a decade ago, where his meticulous approach to data collection and interpretation has proven invaluable. Park's ability to identify subtle aerodynamic inefficiencies and translate them into actionable improvements has earned him the respect of the entire team. He is known for his relentless pursuit of marginal gains and his unwavering commitment to pushing the boundaries of aerodynamic performance.

Park believes in a holistic approach to wind tunnel testing, emphasizing the importance of collaboration between engineers, drivers, and mechanics. He fosters an open communication environment, encouraging everyone to contribute their insights and perspectives. His visionary outlook and dedication to innovation have made him a key asset to Brad Jones Racing's success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight wave
physical.description: A man of average height with a focused gaze and a warm, approachable smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when analyzing data.
Insists on listening to classical music during wind tunnel simulations to 'harmonize the airflow'.
